fairness: Use the same common completion model, tool definitions, assets, prompts and cumulative limits in every learned/search arm. Its state must be each arm’s actual generated furniture scene, not a teacher-corrected layout.
theory: For downstream outcome Y, common child policy pi_c still yields P(Y|parent scene S). A furniture decision intervention changes S and may therefore change child selection/placement; this is part of the total effect. Freezing child layouts from a reference arm would instead change the estimand and bypass real failures.
no_guarantee: Normal return of native add_manipulands does not imply completed requirements: it can return empty, skip unsuitable parents, or catch local exceptions. Current tests execute those control-flow cases, not physical feasibility.
